name: SOC-001: Windows Suspicious Process Creation
description: Detects suspicious Windows process creation events including execution of LOLBins (certutil, bitsadmin, mshta), script hosts (wscript, cscript), and hidden PowerShell/CMD commands.
aql_expression: SELECT QIDNAME(qid) as EventName, sourceIP, destinationIP, username, LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) as LogSource, payload, starttime FROM events WHERE LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) ILIKE '%Windows%' AND (payload ILIKE '%cmd.exe%/c%' OR payload ILIKE '%powershell.exe%-enc%' OR payload ILIKE '%certutil%-urlcache%' OR payload ILIKE '%bitsadmin%/transfer%' OR payload ILIKE '%wscript.exe%' OR payload ILIKE '%cscript.exe%' OR payload ILIKE '%mshta.exe%') ORDER BY starttime DESC LAST 300 SECONDS
